item.title: Gitting Started
item.description: I did not learn git until I started working professionally. In the university we learned about SVN. We did not really use branches, wee followed trunk based development in all of the group projects. At my second job I had to get into git quickly. It was overwhelming at first, but luckily I had patient mentors, who answered my questions with enthusiasm, and taught me best practices that I still carry with me.
